notes:
Replication reports only a shared p bound for the two moral-judgment questions in its BAC predictor analysis; no effect size or test statistic is printed for that analysis. The printed h values refer to task contrasts, not the alcohol predictor, and are not extracted. Original acquisition: DOI landing unavailable through web tool; OpenAlex supplied no best OA location; HAL record verified the title but provided only an ISTEX link, which returned HTML rather than full PDF. No statistics taken from secondary accounts or the original abstract. Replication HTML title and full Methods/Results verified; publisher PDF used to verify page locations. Supplementary material inspected; no additional statistics for the selected BAC-to-judgment analysis located.
Source follow-up: Study 1 and supplied page identify footbridge correlation. Switch correlation is separately r=.17, p=.17; combined-study r=.31 is not Study 1.
